issues: 开场的拉丝金属牌堆特写之后，整屏切成白纸页面，暗场质感在镜头中段整个丢掉，后半段是一块平铺的浅色网页
收尾停在页面底部几排卡的正视平铺上，看不到"满板"的整体体量，尾帧没有构图也没有文字
金属→页面的过渡中段是半透明叠化的灰色，牌堆所在的桌面和页面不是同一个空间
卡片阴影是暖棕色浅影，放在暗桌上发脏；整镜头没有景深与光的方向
changes: look 换成 graphite（近单色暗场 + 一点香槟金）：整镜头都在一张暗色拉丝石墨桌面上，牌堆放在真实 projects 页面板的右侧；页面板始终是摆在暗桌上的白色展板，暗/亮反差贯穿到最后一帧
拉远时"灯"从牌堆亮到页面板：板面开场盖着 0.88 暗层，以牌堆为圆心的柔边光圈把它照亮，落进暗区的卡同步压暗
相机是一条连续 Hermite 样条：低机位侧斜绕牌堆 → 拉远正视板顶 → 追着越发越快的牌往板尾走、同时升高后仰侧转 → 落在一张跑道式俯瞰（26 张卡全部在画，远端压暗做景深），persp 随后仰从 1100 加到 3300
保留发牌核心：预备拍 48/30px、cue = 36 + 4k − 0.0792·k(k−1) 硬加速、8f 俯冲 + 4f 过冲 + 2f press；阴影改成暗桌上的黑色重影、落地后在纸面收成静置影（滞后 ~3f）
满板后左下升起 120px 标语「Every project. / One board.」（800/300 字重对比）+ mono 计数行「26 PROJECTS · 4 TEAMS」；时长 113f → 150f，hold 42f 只留 1.5% 推近
issuesEn: After the brushed-metal pile close-up the whole frame cut to a white page, so the dark-stage quality vanished mid-shot and the second half was a flat light web page
It ended on a frontal view of the bottom rows of the page, so the size of the full board was never visible; the last frame had no composition and no copy
The metal-to-page transition passed through a muddy translucent grey crossfade; the table under the pile and the page did not feel like one space
Card shadows were pale warm browns that looked dirty on the dark table, and the shot had no depth of field or light direction
changesEn: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark with a touch of champagne): the whole shot happens on a dark brushed graphite table, with the pile beside the real projects page board; the board stays a white panel lying on the dark table, so the dark/light contrast holds to the last frame

On the pull-out the light spreads from the pile onto the board: the board starts under a 0.88 dark layer that a soft iris centred on the pile lifts, and cards landing in the dark zone are dimmed to match

The camera is one continuous Hermite spline: a low oblique orbit around the pile, a pull-out to a frontal view of the board top, a chase down the board after the accelerating deal while rising, tilting and rolling, ending on a runway-style overview with all 26 cards in frame and the far end darkened for depth (perspective grows from 1100 to 3300)

The deal itself is kept: 48/30px anticipation, hard-accelerating cues 36 + 4k - 0.0792k(k-1), 8f dive + 4f overshoot + 2f press; shadows are now black on the dark table and settle into resting shadows on the paper about 3f after the card

Once the board is full a 120px tagline "Every project. / One board." (800 vs 300 weight) rises at bottom left with a mono counter line "26 PROJECTS · 4 TEAMS"; duration goes from 113f to 150f with a 42f hold and only a 1.5% push-in
